column2: The Destined White Mage's second ability
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text in part (template error; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): two 2025-10-02 rulings call the life-gain trigger the card's 'second ability', but its second ability is '{W}, {T}: Another target creature you control gains lifelink until end of turn.', which neither triggers nor puts counters; the life-gain trigger is its third ability (Lifelink comes first), as its three other rulings of that day number it. Likely origin: Aerith Gainsborough's ruling (2025-06-06) 'Aerith Gainsborough's second ability triggers just once for each life-gaining event, whether it's 1 life from Al Bhed Salvagers or 3 life from Balamb T-Rexaur.', right for Aerith (Lifelink, then its life-gain trigger), copied with the name swapped. What both rulings say of the life-gain trigger agrees with the card and stays cited (tests/rulings/r_p158_triggers.rs); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
